Hospital admissions related to influenza rose sharply, with 14.09 cases per 100,000 people requiring inpatient care, up from 10.69 per 100,000 in the prior week. ICU admissions also saw an uptick, reaching 0.50 per 100,000, a troubling sign that severe cases are escalating.
